dilated aorta, fluttering of anterior MV leaflet
: surg = mainstay of TX, optimize medical mgnt of comorbidities (HF TX)
: obstruct of flow into LV ⇣ EDV
» Progresses over years from aSx to SXS of profound HF
: dyspnea, fatigue, dysphagia (esophageal compress by enlrg LA),
: hoarseness caused by enlrg LA compressing
Norm opening @ start of diastole), loud S1
(diuretics, ACEI, BBs), AFIB TX (BBs, CCBs, anticoagulation)

high-pitched early diastol decrescendo murmur @ LUSB
: directed @ cause of PR, annual f/u for H&P & TTE

mid-diastolic rumbling murmur @ LLSB w/ opening snap
